title: Cache Engineering for Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.28577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. translated_title: 面向智能体的缓存工程
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够处理日益复杂的任务，在漫长的观察与动作轨迹中持续导航。随着这些轨迹不断增长，键值（KV）缓存的输入/输出与存储成为主导性成本。轨迹还可能超出LLM的最大上下文长度，因此需要对活跃缓存的增长加以控制。已有工作采用上下文工程，通过裁剪或摘要历史内容来减小缓存规模。然而，修改轨迹前缀会使后续的缓存状态失效，并触发对保留上下文代价高昂的重新预填充；而为限制重新预填充成本而保留过少的上下文时，任务准确率也会受到损害。我们提出“缓存工程”这一新方案。它允许智能体直接控制其活跃的KV缓存，而无需修改轨迹或对保留上下文进行重新预填充。具体而言，智能体可以主动使用drop操作将选定的缓存排除在未来注意力之外，并使用repos操作来调整保留键的位置……
tldr: 该论文提出“缓存工程”新范式，使LLM智能体无需修改轨迹或重新预填充上下文，即可通过drop和repos等操作直接控制活跃KV缓存，从而在降低缓存I/O与存储成本的同时保持任务准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "cache engineering," a new scheme that enables LLM agents to directly control their active KV cache via operations such as drop and repos—without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context—thereby reducing cache I/O and storage costs while preserving task accuracy.
